graphics.caption: Folio 0014 Figure 1
graphics.title: Proposition 2: Chord joins within circle
graphics.description: Circle ABC showing that straight line joining two points A, B on the circumference falls wholly within the circle.
graphics.text_reference: Let ABC be a circle, and let two points A, B be taken at random on its circumference; I say that the straight line joined from A to B will fall within the circle...
